$comment: PROVISIONAL seed catalogue for HCG Store. HCG ERP is the source of truth for the product registry; replace these entries through the provider layer once the ERP contract exists. registry.centralId is set only for IDs HCG has confirmed (main-site handoff, 16 Nov 2026); entitlements are never granted for a product without one. editions[].centralEditionKey is the module-scope key (scope_key "edition:<key>") HCG checks for that edition; null means unmapped, and an unmapped edition never falls back to a product-wide grant. Prices are never stored here: they come only from the Store server's offers. See docs/CATALOGUE.md before editing. Run `npm run validate:catalogue` after every change.

products.name: HCG Clarity
products.summary: Turn scattered information into clear instructions and useful deliverables: briefs, presentations and prompt files, with every output kept in History.
description: HCG Clarity takes source material through four steps — Sources, Distil, Refine and Create — and turns it into briefs, editable presentations and prompt files. Every output is kept in History.

Clarity consolidates the working parts of HCG RePrompter, Distil and Presentation Studio into one application, and opens RePrompter and Distil backup files. It runs as a local web app and as a desktop app for macOS.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.1.0, the first consolidated pre-release. The packaged macOS app passes its automated test in CI; it is ad-hoc signed and not notarised, and real AI-provider calls have not been verified.

platforms.note: Electron desktop app for Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 12.0 or later in the development configuration.
Runs locally on the user's computer (localhost); not a hosted service.

currentFeatures: Sources: import PDF, Word, text and images, with on-device OCR (English and Norwegian)
Distil: select excerpts with line references using four strategies
Refine: local analysis and revisions of instructions
Create: a Clarity brief and an editable .pptx presentation
History of every output, and import of RePrompter and Distil backups
plannedFeatures: HCG Connect accounts, HCG AI and collaboration
requirements: Desktop: macOS 12.0 or later on Apple Silicon (arm64)
Local web app: runs on your own computer
